card.name: The word foods before content descriptors
card.fires_on: The word "foods" (or "drink") when it is the subject or object of a diet or drug-interaction sentence. It is usually followed by a phrase like "rich in", "containing" or "fortified with".

modes.label: Foods before rich in / containing
modes.description: "foods" in diet advice, where the next words name a nutrient the foods contain.
modes.example: Adjusting your diet to include<< foods>> rich in iron, folic acid,

modes.label: Foods in interaction warnings
modes.description: "foods" or "drink" paired with drugs or beverages in avoid or interaction statements.
modes.example: Avoid food or<< drink>> containing grapefruit when taking LUPK

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with words meaning "rich in", "containing" or "with", which describe the food's content.
card.plain: It fires on the word "foods" when the next words will say what the foods contain, like "rich in iron".
